name: Supply Crate
summary: The Supply Crate is abandoned excavation gear sought by Sigrun Ironhew in the Badlands. Its contents could help his hungry company.

sections.title: Left Behind
sections.body: After leaving the Uldaman excavation site in haste, Sigrun Ironhew's company abandoned wagons and supply crates. Ogres from Camp Kosh seized their equipment, including a cart carrying weapons. The company has been left without food, and Sigrun asks you to recover a Supply Crate.

faq.answer: Sigrun Ironhew wants you to retrieve the Supply Crate for his company in the Badlands.

faq.q: Where was the Supply Crate left?
faq.answer: The crate was among the supplies abandoned when Sigrun Ironhew's company fled the Uldaman excavation site.

faq.q: Why does Sigrun need the crate?
faq.answer: Sigrun's company lost its food supplies after ogres from Camp Kosh seized their equipment. He asks you to recover a Supply Crate.
Ogres from Camp Kosh seized the company's abandoned equipment, including a cart carrying weapons.
Sigrun thanks you, then says the company will go out to find food that night.
